function: Select the desired nodes to be disconnected from Floor Rigid Diaphragms created internally for each floor by the program's Story function.
menu_path: From the Main Menu select [Boundary] tab > [Advanced] group > [Diaphragm Disconnect]
usage:
Select the desired nodes and click the Apply button to add or delete nodes disconnected from the diaphragms.

Options

Add or delete Diaphragm disconnection conditions.

No : Consecutive numbers

Node Number : Selected node numbers
